title: Data locality opt-in tiers + negotiable retention bands (pricing experiment & SCCs readiness)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Run a pricing and packaging experiment that introduces opt-in data locality tiers (EU-only, EU+UK, Global) coupled with negotiable retention bands (7d/30d/90d/indefinite) and an SCCs-ready checkbox flow for enterprise contract intake. Goal: surface incremental revenue for customers requiring regional residency while minimizing negotiation overhead and legal review cycles. Deliverables: PRD, tiered pricing table + margin model, contract language templates (SCCs + standard DPA addenda), front-line sales playbook and Security Questionnaire preflight checklist for Solutions Engineering.

acceptance_criteria: Console: Signup flow surfaces three residency tiers and retention bands with descriptive copy and pricing estimates
Backend: Requests with EU-only tag route to EU storage and EU compute (or documented fallback) during pilot
Legal: DPA + SCCs addendum templatized and accessible to Sales; SCCs checkbox triggers automated playbook
Billing: Surcharge implementation and invoice line items for residency/retention are accurate in staging invoices
Pilot: At least 2 pilot customers convert and provide feedback on price/retention tradeoffs
next_steps: Finalize tiered pricing table and margin sensitivity analysis (owner: Luca)
Produce copy and microcopy for Console opt-in modal (owner: Design)
Create DPA + SCCs addendum template and subprocessors disclosure (owner: Legal)
Kick off infra tickets for region routing and storage tagging (owners: Eng infra leads)
Schedule pilot kickoff with AE owners and Solutions Engineering (owner: PM)
notes: Trade-offs: aggressive surcharge improves unit economics but may reduce conversion for mid-market customers; recommend A/B testing at two price points.
SCCs strategy: prefer checkbox + automated addendum generation to avoid manual redlining on initial deals; escalate to Legal for exceptions.
Retention bands: provide defaults (30d) with opt-in for 90d/indefinite for enterprise only; limit indefinite retention to customers with approved security posture.
Subprocessors: publish an up-to-date subprocessors list in Console and link it in the DPA; Legal recommends quarterly cadence for updates.
Measurement: track conversion rate, time-to-contract, legal cycles (days), and incremental MRR from residency tiers during 8-week experiment window.
